hero.headline: Property Management & Real Estate Brokerage in Abuja
hero.sub: Traction Properties and Managers is a property management, commercial brokerage, and real estate advisory firm based in Abuja, Nigeria. We help property owners, corporate investors, and tenants buy, sell, and manage residential and commercial property, handling everything from due diligence and documentation to day-to-day tenant management and facility upkeep.

entries.q: What services does Traction Properties offer in Abuja?
entries.a: Traction Properties and Managers provides property management, commercial brokerage, and real estate advisory in Abuja, Nigeria. This includes tenant management, tenant verification, rent collection, legal representation, facility management, and renovation and maintenance for homeowners, corporate investors, and commercial landlords.

entries.q: Does Traction Properties manage properties I already own, or only handle sales?
entries.a: Both. We handle full-scale property management for homeowners and commercial landlords, including tenant management, rent collection, and maintenance, and we also broker property sales and rentals across Abuja.
Traction Properties is based in Abuja, Nigeria, and manages and brokers properties across the city, including areas such as Kado, Mabushi, and Wuse.

entries.q: How do I list a property or get a property manager through Traction Properties?
entries.a: Contact a property manager directly through the WhatsApp link on this page. Our team will walk you through the process, whether you are listing a property for sale or rent, or need ongoing property management.
